youtube_title: Your Phone Didn't Buzz. Your Brain Did. #Shorts
youtube_description:
Felt your phone vibrate, checked, nothing? It's called phantom vibration: your brain is so primed for notifications that it reads a shirt rub as a buzz. In one study, 89% of college students had experienced it (Drouin, Kaiser & Miller, Computers in Human Behavior, 2012). Fix: turn vibration off, keep notifications only for apps that matter, keep the phone in your bag.
Source: Drouin, Kaiser & Miller (2012).
